scope: Foundational C2 export primitives: private local artifact storage with explicit deletion and a pure exact-location report-snapshot JSON validator/serializer.

checks.command: Ruff check on the new export modules and focused tests
Python compilation and git diff hygiene

limitations: The serializer requires an independently authorized, bounded reader and is not yet connected to a Gateway route or worker.
The local storage port is not wired to an export queue and has no R2 adapter or automatic retention cleanup.
These two primitives do not close the C2 export-request capability gate or authorize broad stakeholder downloads.
Capability classifications and MAN-CAP acceptance remain unchanged.
